'''Ambaril''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandaar]], the throneworld of the [[Kingdom of Cron]] after [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot's]] [[Death/Legends|death]] and the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Cronese Mandate/Legends|Cronese Mandate]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
